task: GEN: three populations within one defect class (pre-registered test, stored data only)
scripts: repair-law/work/SIM/cf1/gen/ (gen_geom.py, gen_static.py, gen_ident.py, gen_decide.py, gen_groups.py, gen_lifecheck.py, gen_replicate.py, gen_build.py, sync.sh)

inputs.geometry: oph_defects.fedgeom.build(L) cache on box A (L3..L9); run.json geometry for the template

answer_per_property.P1.1 frame class relative to F* (T+, T-,: no: occupancy uniform within 0.6 %; no class heterogeneous at the corrected level (largest chi2/phi 23.0 for 4 dof, class 3, p 1.2e-4)
answer_per_property.P1.2 three axial classes of F*: no: class 3 heterogeneous on L10 (ax_z 0.6 % low, p 3.3e-5), L9 pairwise |z| <= 3.1, not three distinct groups; other classes homogeneous
answer_per_property.P1.3 ordered frame pair (L, R) = templat: no: classes 2, 3, 4 heterogeneous, face rates within 1.2 % of the mean (p 5e-14 to 5e-6), best three-group partitions not confirmed on L9 (pairwise |z| <= 3.7); classes 1, 5 homogeneous
answer_per_property.P1.6 outer / equatorial / inner and lati: no: classes 2, 4 outer +0.4 %, inner -0.35 % (p 1e-14), L9 confirms outer vs inner only (z -4.9), equatorial not distinct; two levels, not three
answer_per_property.P1.7 glued ports on the face: no: classes 2, 4 about 1 to 2 % fewer on faces with two glued ports (p 6e-7, 3e-6), L9/L8 pairwise |z| <= 3.7
answer_per_property.P2.1 separation of one-pair carriers: no: one mode per class ((1,5) at d = 3, (2,4) and (3,3) at d = 2)
answer_per_property.P2.4 partner class: no: one or two dominant partners (class 1: 5 at 0.989; class 4: 2 at 0.925; class 3: 3 at 0.936)
answer_per_property.P3.1 birth sweep: no: one or two significant modes (sweep 0; second modes at sweeps 9 to 40, carrier tier reading ii, or 252 to 316, screen alive classes 1 and 5)
answer_per_property.P3.2 number of moves: no: one or two significant modes
answer_per_property.P3.3 lifetime: yes by the pre-registered rule, for all identities (not for the protected ones): classes 3 (carrier L6/L5, screen L10/L9) and 4 (screen L10/L9; conjugate 2 confirms) under reading ii; the groups are lifetime 1 to 3-5 depth, ordinary contact times, and survivors to the end of the run (94 to 99 % alive, position set by the run length); alive identities have one mode in every class
answer_per_property.P4.1 valence (pentagonal cells and plaqu: no (two-valued): no difference resolved (pooled L5 to L9: |z| <= 1.23; 0 to 1 screen defects on the 60 pentagonal plaquettes)
answer_per_property.P4.2 level-0 ancestor: no: all classes homogeneous over the 20 base faces on both tiers (p >= 0.065)

three_way_split_found.property: P3.3 identity lifetime, all identities, reading ii (count per unit ln(1 + depth))
three_way_split_found.not_found_for: identities alive at the end (protected defects): one lifetime mode in every class and tier

geometry.fixed_frame_definition: the frame whose three two-fold axes are the coordinate axes of the port vectors = the routing frame (tangent_x, tangent_y, normal) of every carrier
